    SELECT "o"."Id", "o"."Comment", "o"."CompletedAt", "o"."CreatedAt", "o"."Status", "o"."TotalAmount", "o"."UpdatedAt", "o"."UserId"
    FROM "Orders" AS "o"
    WHERE "o"."UserId" = @__userId_0 AND "o"."Status" <> 4 AND "o"."Status" <> 5
    ORDER BY "o"."CreatedAt" DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS "t"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "o0"."Id", "o0"."OrderId", "o0"."ProductId", "o0"."Quantity", "o0"."UnitPrice", "p"."Id" AS "Id0", "p"."Category", "p"."CreatedAt", "p"."Description", "p"."ImageUrl", "p"."IsAvailable", "p"."Name", "p"."Price", "p"."SortOrder", "p"."UpdatedAt"
    FROM "OrderItems" AS "o0"
    INNER JOIN "Products" AS "p" ON "o0"."ProductId" = "p"."Id"
) AS "t0" ON "t"."Id" = "t0"."OrderId"

FROM (
    SELECT "o"."Id", "o"."Comment", "o"."CompletedAt", "o"."CreatedAt", "o"."Status", "o"."TotalAmount", "o"."UpdatedAt", "o"."UserId"
    FROM "Orders" AS "o"
    WHERE "o"."UserId" = @__userId_0 AND "o"."Status" <> 4 AND "o"."Status" <> 5
    ORDER BY "o"."CreatedAt" DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS "t"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "o0"."Id", "o0"."OrderId", "o0"."ProductId", "o0"."Quantity", "o0"."UnitPrice", "p"."Id" AS "Id0", "p"."Category", "p"."CreatedAt", "p"."Description", "p"."ImageUrl", "p"."IsAvailable", "p"."Name", "p"."Price", "p"."SortOrder", "p"."UpdatedAt"
    FROM "OrderItems" AS "o0"
